title: Long File Ids
prompt: Fix file IDs to include the full parent chain (project, bundle, folder hierarchy). Currently buildFileID and File.GetID() return short IDs like 💻designtsx. They should return long IDs like 👤semio📚js🗃️sketchpad💻designtsx that include the full ancestor chain.
